name: ctxforge
description: Deterministic prompt engineer for AI coding agents — stack-aware, GitHub-aware, gap-aware. Scans your Cargo.toml / package.json / pyproject.toml / go.mod to attach per-dep doc URLs. Inlines specific GitHub issues, PRs, releases, and files via gh:// URIs. Flags when bundle imports don't match attached docs. 31 MCP tools. Never calls an LLM — the agent does.
